name: qwen-9b-only
description: Single-model demonstration configuration: qwen/qwen3.5-9b in every slot, routed via OpenRouter so both analysts can run in parallel (the local MLX equivalent would serialize on the per-machine mutex). Built 2026-05-23 to test whether Ora's pipeline architecture lifts a 9B model's output to useful structured analysis. The OpenRouter 9B is the full-precision twin of the local OptiQ 4-bit MLX bundle — same base model, same family, slight quality bump from full precision. Target story: this configuration's results demonstrate what a $1K consumer Mac with 16 GB RAM could produce locally (via the OptiQ 4-bit) with the same architecture. No cascade fallback — if the model fails, the step genuinely degrades.
